const props = defineProps<{ id: string; trend: number[] }>();
const name = defineModel<string>('name', { required: true });
const amount = defineModel<number>('amount', { required: true });
const paid = defineModel<boolean>('paid', { required: true });
const emit = defineEmits<{ remove: [] }>();

// The fields keep their presses: the row is dragged by its grip.

// The last six months, drawn once on a canvas: the clone copies its pixels.
const canvas = useTemplateRef<HTMLCanvasElement>('canvas');
onMounted(() => {
  const element = canvas.value!;
  const context = element.getContext('2d')!;
  const { width, height } = element;
  const max = Math.max(...props.trend, 1);
  const points = props.trend.map((value, index) => [
    (index / (props.trend.length - 1)) * (width - 4) + 2,
    height - 3 - (value / max) * (height - 6),
  ]);
  context.lineWidth = 2;
  context.lineJoin = 'round';
  context.strokeStyle = '#42b883';
  context.beginPath();
  points.forEach(([x, y], index) => (index ? context.lineTo(x!, y!) : context.moveTo(x!, y!)));
  context.stroke();
});
</script>

});

const emit = defineEmits<{ move: [ids: Key[]]; show: [] }>();

/** The pill is sucked into the folder's icon: `over` is the folder it was dropped on. */
const intoFolder: DropAnimation = ({ overlay, from, over, reducedMotion }) => {
  const icon = over?.element.querySelector('svg')?.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (!icon || reducedMotion) return overlay.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: 150, fill: 'forwards' });
  // The box scales around its top left corner: place it by its center instead.
  const at = (x: number, y: number, scale: number) =>
    `translate3d(${x - (from.width * scale) / 2}px, ${y - (from.height * scale) / 2}px, 0) scale(${scale})`;
  const start = { x: from.left + from.width / 2, y: from.top + from.height / 2 };
  const end = { x: icon.left + icon.width / 2, y: icon.top + icon.height / 2 };
  return overlay.animate(
    [
      { transform: at(start.x, start.y, 1), opacity: 1 },
      // A little lift first, then down into the folder.
      { transform: at(start.x + (end.x - start.x) * 0.15, start.y - 10, 0.9), opacity: 1, offset: 0.25 },
      { transform: at(end.x, end.y, 0.12), opacity: 0.4 },
    ],
    { duration: 420, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.2, 1)', fill: 'forwards' },
  );
};

  disabled: () => props.open,
  overOverlay: MovePill,
  overDropAnimation: intoFolder,
  onDrop: (event) => emit('move', event.active.ids),
});

      { id: 'guides', title: 'Guides', section: true, children: [{ id: 'theming', title: 'Theming' }] },
      { id: 'faq', title: 'FAQ' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'blog', title: 'Blog', section: true, children: [{ id: 'launch', title: 'Launch post' }] },
  { id: 'pricing', title: 'Pricing' },
];

/** The sections from the top down to the node `key` (that node included), or `null` if it isn't there. */
export const trail = (nodes: MenuNode[], key: Key): MenuNode[] | null => {
  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (node.id === key) return [node];
    const below = node.children && trail(node.children, key);
    if (below) return [node, ...below];
  }
  return null;
};

/** `Docs › Guides` for the section `guides`, `the top level` for none (`null`). */
export const pathOf = (nodes: MenuNode[], section: Key | null | undefined) =>
  section == null ? 'the top level' : (trail(nodes, section) ?? []).map((node) => node.title).join(' › ');
